'''Kapurung''' ({{langx|rob|pugalu}}) is a dish from [[South Sulawesi]], especially the [[Luwu Regency|Luwu]] region.<ref>{{Cite web|date=July 26, 2023|title=Kapurung, Kuliner dengan Cita Rasa Asam dan Segar Khas Sulawesi Selatan|url=https://www.liputan6.com/regional/read/5353003/kapurung-kuliner-dengan-cita-rasa-asam-dan-segar-khas-sulawesi-selatan|language=Indonesian|first=Switzy|last=Sabandar|website=Liputan6|access-date=16 Oct 2025}}</ref>

This food is made from [[sago]] essence or flour.<ref name="Typical">{{cite web|url=https://www.fimela.com/lifestyle/read/4339954/resep-kapurung-khas-sulawesi-selatan|title=Resep Kapurung khas Sulawesi Selatan|language=Indonesian|first=Febi Anindya|last=Kirana|date=19 July 2022|accessdate=16 Oct 2025|publisher=Fimela.com}}</ref> Kapurung is cooked with a mixture of [[fish]] or [[chicken]] meat and various vegetables.<ref>{{Cite web|date=27 December 2017|title=Kapurung Palopo, Menu Kebersamaan di Pergantian Tahun|url=https://www.liputan6.com/regional/read/3206773/kapurung-palopo-menu-kebersamaan-di-pergantian-tahun|language=Indonesian|first=Eka|last=Hakim|website=Liputan6|access-date=16 Oct 2025}}</ref>
